releases.name: Release V 1.1.0
releases.html: Improves the Search Everywhere palette with a refreshed layout and single-click result opening. When no source editor is open, the palette now searches IDE actions only. The README has also been updated to reflect the current menu and feature set.

releases.name: Beta Release V 1.0.0
releases.html:
This release includes the Format X source formatter and GitHub publishing tools for RAD Studio. GitHub sign-in uses a personal access token, with repository access checks, file and folder selection, push progress, and optional release uploads. The Git window is dockable. The PDF viewer is still in development.

Before running from RAD Studio, open Run > Parameters. Set Host application to your RAD Studio installation’s bds.exe (use Browse if needed; for example, C:\Program Files (x86)\Embarcadero\Studio\23.0\bin\bds.exe). Set Parameters to:

This launches a separate RAD Studio instance with an isolated settings profile, helping protect your main IDE configuration during testing.

There are still bugs in this release. Please report issues and send feature suggestions to lunex.corpofficial@gmail.com.
